title: McKesson Says Cyberattack May Disrupt Services as Hackers Claim Patient Data Theft
dek: The healthcare distributor says it was hacked and expects intermittent service degradation. Hackers claim they stole millions of patient records, a claim not independently verified in the company’s statement.
socialCaption: McKesson says a cyberattack may cause intermittent service degradation, while hackers claim they stole millions of patient records. For healthcare operators, the immediate issue is supply-chain continuity—and the key details are still unresolved.
